about: Every asset in SCION 13's threshold film. Nothing found is drawn or played: no kit footage, no Quick, Draw! drawing, no archive frame, no photograph, no recording. The picture and the sound are computed by the scripts in build/ from the score.

assets.what: the dog's decision trace (state, x, act intentions per frame), the person's circumstances, the door, the voice timeline
assets.operation: read; drives the primary trajectories: dog x, crouch, ear, tail, wag, moving; person x, sit, reach, low hand, mouth; door ajar/open; voice onsets

assets.what: the dog's rigid pieces: six torso discs (spheres) on a spine that bends for crouch and lying, two neck discs, a skull, two muzzle discs, a nose, two eyes, four two-bone legs with paws
assets.operation: synthesized: performed trajectories (heading, head heading, lie, rest, look, head height, fear) keyed to the score's choice times; legs by 2-bone IK with stance feet planted by distance travelled

assets.what: 180 body fringe strips (15 rings x 12 rows), 20 neck-ruff strips, 10 head strips (forelock, cheeks, beard), 3 dewlap strips, 2 five-node ear flaps with 16 feather strips, a six-node tail with 20 feather strips, 12 leg-feather strips
assets.operation: synthesized secondary links (inertial spring-dampers, gravity, wind drag, collision masks); drawn in build/draw.js as torn crepe/tissue ribbons with rounded glued tops, a crease line and torn tips, palette cream/oat/ochre/rust/charcoal

assets.what: a person in a long coat and scarf: torso, head (profile disc, nose, eye, hair cap), arms and legs as paper pieces; hair (7 strands), scarf (2 tails), coat (3 tails) as secondary links
assets.rights: made here; not a likeness of any real person

assets.what: the house cut in section at the doorway (room floor, back wall, rug, picture, standing lamp, door leaf on a spring-damper hinge, outside siding, jamb, sill), the porch (boards, back rail, posts, steps), the yard, dusk sky bands, hills, moon
assets.operation: synthesized torn-edge polygons projected by an orthographic diorama camera (yaw 16 deg, pitch 12 deg)

assets.what: 8 tissue strips hung from the lintel, drawn to the far side of the doorway
assets.operation: secondary links; collide with the dog's body and the person's arm; a draft blows them when the door opens

assets.what: 34 reeds (yard by the steps, behind the rail)
assets.operation: secondary links rooted in the ground; wind; collide with the dog

assets.what: "Come here." x2 (calls), "It's all right." x2 and "Come in." (soft)
assets.operation: formant synthesis (glottal pulse train, aspiration, 3 cascade resonators per phoneme with glides); levels in build/cache/voice_levels.json

assets.what: dusk wind, crepe rustle of the dog, reeds, curtain, coat/scarf, paw taps, ear flaps, door creak, room hum, card tears
assets.operation: filtered noise and tones driven by the solver's measured energies, gusts, paw touchdowns and hinge speed
used for the title and end cards only

assets.rights: public domain / CC BY 4.0 as recorded there
assets.operation: not used; the dog's proportions are invented (a long-coated, bearded-collie-type build)
